fill.$description: Cover-fallback surface family for the Typographic Cover atom. Surface-vs-mark framing: paper is the ground, ink is the mark. Each swatch ships a fill, an ink/primary, and an ink/secondary tuned to sit on it without contrast collision. In dark mode the grounds invert to chalkboard tones and the inks shift to chalk-colored counterparts. Use exclusively as cover grounds — these are not general surface colors and should not appear behind UI.

strong.$description: Error state — strong fill/text/stroke. Sourced from non-vivid red-cool ramp (vividness reserved for destructive actions per Button composition notes). Light: red-cool/60 (#9e394b, 5.88:1 on cream paper — AA normal). Dark: red-cool/40 (#e16b80, 5.35:1 on dark surface — AA normal). Aimed one rung darker on Light than initial proposal after @brand-designer ratification 2026-05-08 — original /50 read at 4.08:1, just under AA-normal and visually under-alarming on warm paper.
